[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making the perfect scrambled eggs, including using fresh eggs, whisking well, adding milk or cream, controlling heat, using butter or oil, not over-stirring, not overcooking, and adding flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For adding avocado to scrambled eggs, assistant suggested mashing it separately, adding it towards the end, and not over-mixing.
